howToPlay: Use the basic attack to drop ants and gain speed and damage boosts while hitting enemies at the edge of your range. Use the Super to close the gap or bounce off walls to reposition. Utilize gadgets like For The Queen to quickly spread ants or Worker Ants to improve your survivability.
gears: Equip HEALTH to capitalize on your role as a tank and SPEED to maneuver quickly across the map. Use DAMAGE to increase your output once you are low on health or GADGET COOLDOWN to use your abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who enjoy aggressive tank gameplay that rewards strategic positioning near scattered ants.
